[SWS_DM_00421] Identification of a Diagnostic Client
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04005
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall identify a
Diagnostic Client
by
means of the tuple of
sourceAddr
and
globalChannelId
provided by the TP Layer
on call of
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolMgr::In-
dicateMessage
, see [SWS_DM_00347].
